title: stats projects
description: Projects and processes a stats node runs and monitors. Drop this at /etc/stats/projects.json, or as any number of files in /etc/stats/projects.d/*.json. The node supervises every process declared here: it starts them, restarts them according to their policy, keeps their logs, samples their CPU and memory, and reports all of it to the hub as a first-class thing rather than a pid that happens to be running.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Only 1 exists.

identifier.description: Stable id: letters, digits, dash and underscore. Used in the API, so changing it is a rename.

env.description: Environment variables. Values are used literally; no shell expansion.

command.description: What to run. An array is exec'd directly (no shell, no quoting rules). A string is split on whitespace, or passed to `sh -c` when `shell` is true.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the id.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory inherited by every process in the project.

envFiles.description: Files of KEY=value lines loaded before `env`, which wins. Relative paths resolve against `cwd`.

tags.description: Free-form labels, shown as chips and usable as a dashboard filter.

url.description: Where this project is served, linked from its card.

enabled.description: false keeps the project in the file but stops the node acting on it.

processes.description: The processes the node runs for this project.

watch.description: Things this project owns but does not run, grouped onto its card.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the id.

shell.description: Run the command through `sh -c`. Needed for pipes, globs and redirection; avoid it otherwise so signals reach the real process.

autostart.description: Start when the node starts. false leaves it stopped until someone starts it from the dashboard.

restart.description: always: restart on any exit. on-failure: only on a non-zero exit or a signal. never: leave it exited.

restartDelayMs.description: Wait before restarting. Backs off up to 30s while a process keeps failing.

maxRestarts.description: Give up (state: fatal) after this many restarts inside restartWindowSec. 0 never gives up.

restartWindowSec.description: The window maxRestarts is counted over.

user.description: Run as this user. The node must be root; it uses setpriv/su to drop privileges.

stopSignal.description: Signal sent to stop the process, e.g. SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGQUIT.

stopTimeoutSec.description: How long to wait after stopSignal before SIGKILL.

logLines.description: Output lines kept in memory for the log tail.

healthcheck.description: Turns 'the process is running' into 'the process is working'. Failures do not restart the process; they mark it unhealthy on the dashboard.

url.description: http: absolute URL to GET, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000/health

expectStatus.description: http: status codes counted as healthy. Defaults to anything in 200-399.

command.description: command: argv run to completion; exit 0 is healthy.

failures.description: Consecutive failures before the process is called unhealthy.

startPeriodSec.description: Grace period after start during which failures don't count.

systemd.description: Units belonging to this project, e.g. nginx.service.

containers.description: Container names belonging to this project.

ports.description: Ports this project is expected to be listening on.

paths.description: Log files or directories to offer in the log picker for this project.
